source.rationale: escalate-catalog's out_of_scope arm sets includeResponse FALSE: the parser-facing `response` still carries the catalog line, but `user_response` is never assigned, so the key is absent and this node sends the customer nothing (the human takeover speaks instead). manualResponse also suppresses the compression block, so `response` survives verbatim rather than being rewritten to 'Previous turn (...)'.

json.response: Informed the user that request is out of scope and will proceed to escalate to the warehouse team
